title: Answer
description:
The words that name Him Son are now joined to priesthood. The throne and the priesthood are one appointment, spoken to one Man.

God swears a priesthood forever. A line of priests that dies cannot say that.

The priest-king who blessed and received a tenth is shown without father, mother, birth, death, or tribe. The silence of the narrative is part of the testimony, not a gap to be filled in.

He learned obedience by what He suffered. Learning does not deny that He is the exact image of God. The obedience is God’s will, carried through suffering.

Order does not mean a tribal genealogy. It means the kind of priesthood the oath names.
